versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-news-daily skill for curating, summarizing, and analyzing daily front-line AI news.
- Supports structured bilingual search covering global AI updates from top sources.
- Organizes news into major industry events, model updates, academic research, open-source tools, and new tech standards.
- Emphasizes in-depth technical analysis, accurate terminology, and relevance to current developments.
- Outputs structured, Markdown-formatted daily digests suitable for professional and technical audiences.
